{{Quote|The Mandalorians attacked the Hutt palace in record time. By sheer coincidence, I was there to sweep in and clear out the Hutt's medpacs.|Doc|<ref name="Anonymous" />}}
Sometime between [[3647 BBY|3647]]<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Doc}}</ref>&ndash;[[3642 BBY]]<ref name="Time">{{TOR dates|2}}</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Unidentified Hutt (medpacs)|Hutt]] owned a '''palace'''. When the region was stricken by a severe [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] began to hoard [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] in his palace, causing the combat [[Medic/Legends|medic]] [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Doc]] to trick a [[Unidentified Mandalorian clan (Cold War)|clan]] of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warriors into [[Attack on a Hutt's palace|attacking]] the palace. During the fighting, Doc infiltrated the palace and made off with the medpacs, and the battle ended with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of both the clan and the Hutt.<ref name="Anonymous" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hutt's palace was first mentioned in the conversation "Anonymous" with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] companion character Doc in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', which was released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Anonymous" />
